name: losses_by_year
label: Losses by year vs. net worth
description: The year table: losses by kind against that year's net worth, for the 12 years a season aired.

metrics.name: realized_loss
metrics.label: Realized
metrics.description: Everyday money or property actually lost (catastrophic excluded).

metrics.name: hypothetical_loss
metrics.label: Hypothetical
metrics.description: Everyday missed income, e.g. the HBO show and the golf club (catastrophic excluded).

metrics.name: catastrophic_loss
metrics.label: Catastrophic
metrics.description: The divorce, the house fire and Latte Larry's.

metrics.name: total_mishap_loss
metrics.label: Total Mishap Loss
metrics.description: Every kept mishap: realized + hypothetical + catastrophic. Hypothetical losses always count; loss_kind is only a slice.

metrics.name: net_worth_mid
metrics.label: LD's Net Worth
metrics.description: Larry David's net worth that year: the central (mid) estimate from reported figures (see the sources page), with the real 2007 divorce added back. Single-year only.

metrics.name: pct_mishap_to_net_worth
metrics.label: % of Net Worth
metrics.description: That year's total mishap loss / that year's net worth. Single-year only: query it grouped by metric_time__year.

metrics.name: net_worth_after_mishaps
metrics.label: Net Worth After That Year's Mishaps
metrics.description: That year's net worth minus that year's total mishap loss. Single-year only: query it grouped by metric_time__year.
